text: Images, upgraded—introducing ChatGPT Images 2.6. Now with GIFs and reference images. Plus, two new models are coming to the API with 50% faster image generation.
zh: OpenAI：推出 ChatGPT Images 2.6，支持 GIF 与参考图；API 还将上线两款新模型，图像生成提速约 50%。

text: Our security researchers built an autonomous cyber vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and patching pipeline. In a single run with an upcoming cyber model, it validated and generated patches for 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel
zh: OpenAI：安全团队用即将推出的网络安全模型，单次跑通发现—利用—修补流水线，为 Linux 内核 948 个本地提权漏洞验证并生成补丁。

text: We're sharing how our biology research team worked with Claude to map the first 3D structure of a vault particle from bacterial life.
zh: Anthropic：生物学团队借助 Claude，首次解析出细菌生命中 vault 粒子的三维结构。

text: Today, as part of Operation Economic Outcast, Treasury targeted the vast criminal network of India-based Suniel Kumar Sharma and his spouse, Jaspreet Preeti Shahid, who have supported Iran's shadow fleet through a web maritime fraud.
zh: 美国财政部：「经济放逐」行动制裁印度籍 Sharma 夫妇为伊朗影子船队提供假旗等海事欺诈的犯罪网络。

text: The Donroe Doctrine is taking back the Western Hemisphere. "President Trump's 'Donroe Doctrine' has solidified the US grip over almost two-thirds of the Western Hemisphere, cutting deals with pro-America governments, targeting drug cartels, and booting Chinese influence"
zh: 白宫：特朗普「Donroe Doctrine」巩固美对西半球近三分之二的掌控，签亲美协议、打毒卡特尔、排挤中国影响。

text: Join us for @astro_anil and @astro_kutryk's next spacewalk! Tune in here on Nov. 5 at 8:30am ET (1330 UTC) to watch the astronauts install and deploy the second of two new solar arrays on the @Space_Station.
zh: NASA：11月5日美东8:30（UTC 13:30）直播舱外活动，宇航员将安装并展开空间站第二块新太阳能电池板。

text: At last there will be one network with good signal everywhere! — quoting @Starlink: Starlink Mobile is building the first fully-integrated US nationwide satellite and terrestrial network; 5G base stations will leverage Qualcomm chips, starting in 2027
zh: 马斯克：终于会有一张处处信号都好的网络——转评 Starlink Mobile：将建美国首个卫星+地面全国网，5G基站用高通芯片，2027年起部署。

text: Free new dish for all early Starlink customers — quoting: Eligible early customers still on first-generation kits can receive a new Standard kit at no cost
zh: 马斯克：早期星链用户可免费换新天线——转评：仍用首代套件的早期用户可免费获标准套件。

text: Qualcomm's technology is excellent — quoting @Qualcomm: SpaceX selected Qualcomm Dragonwing to accelerate Starlink Mobile's nationwide terrestrial 5G network and a path to AI-native 6G
zh: 马斯克：高通技术很出色——转评高通：SpaceX 选用 Dragonwing 加速 Starlink Mobile 全国地面 5G，并迈向 AI 原生 6G。

text: Data centers in space looking pretty appealing right now
zh: 马斯克：太空数据中心现在看起来相当有吸引力

text: People should always be in control of the future. OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”. People should not cede control of the future to
zh: 奥特曼：人类应始终掌控未来。OpenAI 反对让人类沦为只做“AI 认为值得奖励之事”的角色，人们不应把未来的控制权让给 AI。

text: Try asking Grok to make calls! — quoting: Grok's new calling feature is very impressive. You just tell it who to call and why, and it handles the conversation for you, with a real-time transcript.
zh: 马斯克：试试让 Grok 帮你打电话！（转引：Grok 新增代打电话功能，告诉它打给谁、为什么，它就替你完成通话并实时显示文字记录）

text: New Anthropic research: progress on provable inference for large language models. Here, we introduce FlashProve. Building on established cryptographic techniques, FlashProve allows developers to verify whether a given response came from a given AI model.
zh: Anthropic：发布新研究 FlashProve，基于成熟密码学技术实现大模型「可证明推理」，开发者可验证某条回复是否确实出自指定 AI 模型。

text: ChatGPT and Codex are helping engineers build for the physical world. We're sharing our progress across mechanical design, electrical engineering, and simulation—from helping our hardware teams iterate faster to testing new workflows with industry collaborators.
zh: OpenAI：ChatGPT 和 Codex 正在帮助工程师做实体产品，公布在机械设计、电子工程和仿真方面的进展，既加快自家硬件团队迭代，也与行业伙伴测试新工作流。

text: This smoky specter is the Cat's Head Nebula, captured in intricate detail by @NASAWebb.
zh: NASA：韦布望远镜拍下「猫头星云」精细图像，因形似背对观者蹲坐的猫而得名。

text: Starlink saves lives — quoting: Starlink helped save FIVE lives in the Atlantic. Their boat, Karolina Viking, was filling with water. Its power systems were failing. Rescuers couldn't reach them by radio or satellite phone. The sailors shared their location with rescuers through Starlink.
zh: 马斯克：星链能救命——转引：大西洋上一艘渔船“Karolina Viking”进水、电力失灵，无线电和卫星电话都联系不上救援，船员通过星链发送位置，五人获救。

text: Wow — quoting: 31% of the EU budget is farm subsidies. Defense gets 1.2%. Borders get 2%. Farm handouts get 25x what defense gets and 15x what borders get.
zh: 马斯克：“哇”——转引称欧盟预算31%用于农业补贴，国防仅1.2%、边境2%，农补是国防的25倍。

text: As AI becomes more capable at finding vulnerabilities, defenders need to put it to work before attackers do. We're planning our next internal security sprint at OpenAI and partnering with Cathedral Systems, whose researchers will use our models alongside our teams to challenge
zh: OpenAI：AI 找漏洞的能力越来越强，防守方要抢在攻击者之前用上它；OpenAI 正筹备下一轮内部安全冲刺，并与 Cathedral Systems 合作，让其研究员与我们团队一起用我们的模型做攻防挑战。
